description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for managing properties in a backend API, including endpoints for CRUD operations, listing, and statistics, with embedded Swagger API documentation.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of properties with optional filtering, requiring token authentication.

methods.name: router.get('/stats')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve property statistics, requiring token authentication.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific property by ID, with token authentication and ID validation.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new property, with token authentication and input validation.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing property by ID, requiring token authentication and validation.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a property by ID, requiring token authentication and ID validation.
